description: AI-generated illustrated phone wallpapers; themes below were included in dark portrait composition prompts. Existing original assets retained.

assets.theme: A sophisticated penthouse view over a harbour city at midnight, distant restrained warm gold window lights, a small bowl and chopsticks on a dark ledge in the lower corner, charcoal navy and antique gold.
Quiet Japanese ink-wash mountain lake at night, dark pine silhouettes, tiny muted teal reflection of a crescent moon, a sketchbook and brush in the lower corner, poetic indigo atmosphere.
An empty university athletics track at blue hour under a dark evening sky, very subtle teal and coral lane markings, distant campus silhouettes, sports bag in the lower corner, optimistic quiet.
An empty intimate recording studio at night, grand piano silhouette and small softly glowing mixing console in the lower third, deep plum navy and muted lavender light.
A theatre designer's miniature stage in a dim workshop at night, tiny cardboard scenery and architectural model steps in the lower third, indigo background and restrained violet work light.
A small balcony flower garden after dusk, delicate rose and muted pink flowers around lower corners, soft dark leafy silhouettes and tiny amber window light, deep forest navy.
Empty running track beneath an indigo night sky, starting blocks and running shoes in the lower corner, faint mint lane highlights, distant stadium silhouettes.
An artist's dorm desk by a night window, a closed philosophy book and small canvas with an abstract botanical sketch in the lower third, deep plum and dusty mauve shadows.
A quiet motorcycle workshop at night, dark motorcycle silhouette and hanging boxing gloves in the lower third, charcoal graphite and restrained rust-orange accent lights.
A rooftop observatory at night with a small telescope and a wooden chessboard in the lower corners, deep indigo sky, restrained sapphire points of starlight.
An old-town clocktower archive at night, vintage film camera and a few unlettered photographs on a lower desk, dark walnut, midnight blue and subdued copper highlights.
A riverside bicycle workshop at night, elegant bicycle wheel silhouette and handmade ceramic mug at the bottom, slate navy with subtle moss-green accents.
A planetarium interior with a tiny violet constellation projection over a dark dome, piano keys and a small bird silhouette motif in the lower corner, very dark cobalt violet.
A makerspace bench at night, soldering stand unplugged, circuit boards and a pair of game dice in the lower third, graphite blue and dim cyan accents.
A cozy community kitchen after closing, dark pots, herb sprigs and a recipe notebook with no readable writing along the bottom, dark terracotta and forest slate.
A moonlit wetland boardwalk fading into reeds, small kayak beside the lower bank and a carved wooden bird on a post, very dark blue-green mist.
An empty neighborhood boxing gym at night, gloves and a domino set on a lower bench, distant ring ropes, deep navy and subdued warm amber.
A quiet harbour boathouse at night, folded dark sailcloth and a small moored dinghy in the lower third, muted sea-teal reflections and navy sky.
An old repertory cinema projection booth at night, film reels and a projector silhouette in the lower third, muted amber beam against deep burgundy navy, no posters or text.
A quiet electronics repair desk beside a rainy night window, restored game controllers and an old radio at the bottom, charcoal navy and tiny teal power lights.
A bookbinder's desk at night beside small potted herbs, hand-bound dark notebooks and botanical sketches with no writing at the bottom, deep indigo with restrained violet and sage accents.

An unsettling empty private arena viewing room at midnight, a dark metal ringside bell and abstract fractured violet reflections in the lower third, black plum and subtle crimson accents, elegant threatening stillness, no gore.
A precise watch restoration desk at midnight, a disassembled antique watch and dark gloves in the lower corner, charcoal slate and restrained brass highlights, orderly and substantial.
An empty theatrical rehearsal stage at night, dark velvet curtain edges, a single dim rose spotlight on the lower stage and an unmarked script notebook, ink navy and muted wine red.
A rain-dark wetland path at night, portable field recorder and headphones on a lower wooden railing, subtle rain rings and fern silhouettes, charcoal forest green.
A refined desk overlooking geometric city buildings at night, a chess knight and orderly unmarked financial charts in the lower third, deep graphite, muted burgundy and subtle brass.
